Gadarwara Super Thermal Power Station is a coal based thermal power project located at near by Gangai village in Gadarwara Tehsil in Narsinghpur District in Indian state of Madhya Pradesh. The power plant is one of the coal based power plants of NTPC Limited. are the critical equipment supplier.
Capacity
Its planned capacity is 3,200 MW (4x800 MW). The land for the project is already acquired and the foundation stone for the project was laid in February 2014. NTPC Limited awarded the EPC contract to BHEL for this project. The first unit was synchronised with grid on 30.08.2018 at 05.12 AM IST.
